affine_baseline: 3x3+b least squares with no ridge, same fit/check coordinates, once per image/fold; rank reported. Raw prediction errors plus explicitly clipped display errors. No monotone curves claimed.
objective: Per channel: mean squared encoded-sRGB pixel residual + lambda * mean squared ((d-1)^2 times interior RGB-axis second differences). Sum channel objectives; no data-derived lambda selection.
sampling: Uniform without replacement from each parity's valid coordinates, seed48+100*index+fold; same coordinates for every dimension/lambda. Full opposite parity is check set.
schedule: lambda then fold then source index then dimension; alternating17/33 for each source before next source; no same-image lambda sweep first
color_support: Report check cells not occupied by fit colors at each lattice dimension; support gaps confound extrapolation and do not prove spatial necessity.
convergence: lsq_linear success and, for status3 unbounded solution, LSMR stop in0/1/2/4/5 or optimality<=1e-6. Any nonconvergence or incomplete schedule is INCONCLUSIVE, never global insufficiency.
scope: Post hoc selected5 desirable targets, teacher-assisted within-image representation diagnostic only. Original8 suitability gate remains FAIL. Not after-only prediction, training, dataset acceptance, independent validation, best-LUT search or evidence that LUT is superior.
alignment_gate: Root must pin report SHA and explicitly admit all5 native pairs with matching source/gt sRGB16 hashes. Same dimensions or zero best shift alone are insufficient. No resampling/registration. Untagged groups6/8 remain conditional on sRGB assumption.
stop: No new images, GPU, model forwards, model training, spatial extension or automatic retry. Preserve partial results on600s/tree4GiB stop. Compare all lambda/fold results; never choose settings using check error.
